name: dnd-character-manager
install: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
start: sudo service docker status >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo service docker start; timeout 120 sh -c 'until docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done' && docker info --format 'docker ready: {{.ServerVersion}} ({{.Driver}})'
